translations.web: How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.
translations.bsb: How the gold has become tarnished, the pure gold has become dull! The gems of the temple lie scattered on every street corner.
translations.kjv: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.
